title: Sno Research
text: Welcome to Sno Research. This is a future one-stop shop for data and analysis on money markets, financial plumbing, and macroeconomic frameworks. Separately, but not secondarily, Sno Research equally covers metals markets and their financial plumbing, liquidity managemnet, and their macroeconomic backdrop. Data and analysis are underpinned using quantitative methods in a transparent and rigorous form.

title: Interest Rate Central
text: Implied policy rate paths and meeting-by-meeting probability distributions derived from daily short-term interest rate futures settlement data.

title: Interest Rate Central
text:
Available Central Bank Models

US Federal Reserve (FOMC)
30-Day Fed Funds Futures (ZQ) on CBOT bootstrapped via Regularized WLS.
European Central Bank (ECB)
3-Month €STR Futures (ST3) on Eurex deaveraged via Regularized WLS.
Bank of England (BoE) (Planned)
3-Month SONIA Futures (SON) on ICE Europe.
Bank of Japan (BoJ) (Planned)
3-Month TONA Futures (TONA) on OSE.
